candidates.name: Anchor Construction Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists Toilet Partitions and Washroom Accessories among its specialties as a commercial Division 10 subcontractor offering turn-key general trades on commercial projects.
red_flags: Runs an online material-only shop (restroomwarehouse.com) selling partitions: buy-around risk
No project photos, license number or reviews shown on the homepage
candidates.reason: San Diego commercial Division 10 subcontractor that lists toilet partitions as a core specialty. It also sells partitions online, which is a buy-around risk to manage.
